### `ldp.data.data_source`

A data offer under construction. `offer` adds MIME types before selection. When the source becomes the selection or the drag payload, transfer requests arrive as `send` events carrying a pipe FD the client writes into.

### `ldp.data.data_device`

Per-seat data exchange: selection ownership, primary selection, drag-and-drop driving. Selection set requires seat focus (serial must reference an input event of this seat).

#### Requests

| Opcode | Name | Since | Reply | Arguments |
|---:|---|---:|---|---|
| 1 | `set_selection` | 1 | — | `source: object<data_source>?`, `serial: uint32` |
| 2 | `set_primary_selection` | 1 | — | `source: object<data_source>?`, `serial: uint32` |
| 3 | `start_drag` | 1 | — | `source: object<data_source>`, `origin: object<ldp.core.surface>`, `icon: object<ldp.core.surface>?`, `serial: uint32` |

* `start_drag.serial` — Must reference a button press on this seat.

### `ldp.data.data_offer`

An incoming offer (selection or drag). `offer` events enumerate MIME types; `receive` requests a streaming transfer (write side of a pipe FD is handed to the source). DnD offers additionally negotiate actions.

#### Requests

| 2 | `receive` | 1 | — | `mime: string`, `fd: fd` |
| 3 | `finish` | 1 | — | — |
| 4 | `set_actions` | 1 | — | `actions: bitset<dnd_actions>` |
